files.content:
# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A small offline browser pomodoro timer with a pixel-art theme. Work sessions default to 25 minutes and breaks to 5 minutes.

## How to run

Open index.html in any modern browser. No build step, network access, or external dependencies are required.

## Features

- Start, pause, and reset controls with keyboard and visible focus states
- Large countdown display with work and break mode labels
- Automatic mode switching when the countdown reaches zero
- Responsive centered card layout that works from 360px wide
- Drift-resistant timestamp-based countdown

## File structure

- index.html - page structure
- styles.css - pixel-themed responsive styling
- script.js - timer logic and event wiring

output.explanation: A complete offline pixel-themed Pomodoro timer using only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. The app includes a large countdown, 25-minute work and 5-minute break modes, start/pause/reset controls, timestamp-based drift-resistant timing, automatic mode switching, and responsive accessible styling.

output.goal: Build an offline browser pomodoro timer with 25-minute work and 5-minute break modes, start/pause/reset controls, a large countdown, and a polished pixel-themed responsive UI using only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

phases.name: Setup and HTML Structure
tasks: Create root index.html with relative paths to styles.css and script.js
Add semantic timer card with large countdown display and mode label
Add start, pause, and reset buttons with unique IDs and accessible labels
Ensure all controls are native button elements for keyboard accessibility

phases.name: Pixel-Themed Styling and Responsive Layout
tasks: Create styles.css with a cohesive 3-5 color palette and pixel-style theme
Style centered card, large countdown, and themed background
Add visible hover, focus, and pressed states for all controls
Use system fonts at 16px or larger and ensure layout works from 360px wide

phases.name: Timer Logic and Interaction
tasks: Implement work and break modes with 25-minute and 5-minute durations
Use addEventListener for start, pause, reset, and mode switching behavior
Manage countdown updates with setInterval and prevent timer drift
Update UI countdown, mode label, and button states during operation

phases.name: Accessibility, Documentation, and Validation
tasks: Verify keyboard accessibility and visible focus across all interactive controls
Test responsive behavior at 360px and confirm no external assets or network requests
Create README.md with run instructions and build evidence
Package source archive with root index.html, CSS, JavaScript, and README

risks: Timer drift may occur if only using setInterval without timestamp correction
Small-screen layout may break if spacing or font sizes are not tested at 360px
Accessible focus and keyboard states may be overlooked while styling hover effects
Relative file paths or missing assets could break offline use
Visual polish may be reduced by scope creep around pixel art details
